About these 23 rides

Sunday is the big day: 11 of the 23 ride then. Starts run from 6:00 am to 8:30 pm. After work, 5 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 4 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders and 6 for families. Each one was checked at its source between Oct 1 and Oct 2, 2026.

I’d like to say I ride for everyone else. I ride because it changed me.

In 2027 I ride 10,000 miles, all on the bike, and every ride gets written down. The money goes through the orgs’ own rides. It never touches me.
